vsm1.1:98.1: Evametasmiṃ catubbidhe sīle saddhāya pātimokkhasaṃvaro sampādetabbo.
vsm1.1:98.4: Tasmā yathā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ anavasesaṃ saddhāya samādiyitvā jīvitepi apekkhaṃ akarontena sādhukaṃ sampādetabbaṃ.
vsm1.1:98.5: Vuttampi hetaṃ – ‘‘Kikīva aṇḍaṃ camarīva vāladhiṃ, Piyaṃva puttaṃ nayanaṃva ekakaṃ; Tatheva sīlaṃ anurakkhamānakā, Supesalā hotha sadā sagāravā’’ti.
vsm1.1:98.6: Aparampi vuttaṃ – ‘‘evameva kho pahārāda yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ,
vsm1.1:98.7: taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamantī’’ti (a. ni. 8.19).
vsm1.1:99.1: Imasmiṃ ca panatthe aṭaviyaṃ corehi baddhatherānaṃ vatthūni veditabbāni.
vsm1.1:99.2: Mahāvattaniaṭaviyaṃ kira theraṃ corā kāḷavallīhi bandhitvā nipajjāpesuṃ.
vsm1.1:99.3: Thero yathānipannova sattadivasāni vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā anāgāmiphalaṃ pāpuṇitvā tattheva kālaṃ katvā brahmaloke nibbatti.
vsm1.1:99.4: Aparampi theraṃ tambapaṇṇidīpe pūtilatāya bandhitvā nipajjāpesuṃ.
vsm1.1:99.5: So vanadāhe āgacchante valliṃ acchinditvāva vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā samasīsī hutvā parinibbāyi.
vsm1.1:99.6: Dīghabhāṇakaabhayatthero pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ āgacchanto disvā therassa sarīraṃ jhāpetvā cetiyaṃ kārāpesi.
vsm1.1:99.7: Tasmā aññopi saddho kulaputto – Pātimokkhaṃ visodhento, appeva jīvitaṃ jahe; Paññattaṃ lokanāthena, na bhinde sīlasaṃvaraṃ.
vsm1.1:100.5: Tasmā ‘‘varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tveva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho’’ti (saṃ. ni. 4.235) ādinā nayena
vsm1.1:100.6: ādittapariyāyaṃ samanussaritvā rūpādīsu visayesu cakkhudvārādipavattassa viññāṇassa abhijjhādīhi anvāssavanīyaṃ nimittādiggāhaṃ asammuṭṭhāya satiyā nisedhentena esa sādhukaṃ sampādetabbo.
vsm1.1:101.1: Evaṃ asampādite hi etasmiṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlampi anaddhaniyaṃ hoti aciraṭṭhitikaṃ,
vsm1.1:101.3: Haññate cāyaṃ kilesacorehi, vivaṭadvāro viya gāmo parassa hārīhi.
vsm1.1:101.4: Cittañcassa rāgo samativijjhati, ducchannamagāraṃ vuṭṭhi viya.
vsm1.1:101.5: Vuttampi hetaṃ – ‘‘Rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, Gandhesu phassesu ca rakkha indriyaṃ; Ete hi dvārā vivaṭā arakkhitā, Hananti gāmaṃva parassa hārino’’. ‘‘Yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati; Evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhatī’’ti. (dha. pa. 13);
vsm1.1:102.1: Sampādite pana tasmiṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlampi addhaniyaṃ hoti ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, susaṃvihitasākhāparivāramiva sassaṃ.
vsm1.1:102.2: Na haññate cāyaṃ kilesacorehi, susaṃvutadvāro viya gāmo parassa hārīhi.
vsm1.1:102.3: Na cassa cittaṃ rāgo samativijjhati, succhannamagāraṃ vuṭṭhi viya.
vsm1.1:102.4: Vuttampi cetaṃ – ‘‘Rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, Gandhesu phassesu ca rakkha indriyaṃ; Ete hi dvārā pihitā susaṃvutā, Na hanti gāmaṃva parassa hārino’’. ‘‘Yathā agāraṃ succhannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati; Evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhatī’’ti. (dha. pa. 14);
vsm1.1:103.3: tasmā uppannaṃ rāgaṃ asubhamanasikārena vinodetvā indriyasaṃvaro sampādetabbo, adhunāpabbajitena vaṅgīsattherena viya.
vsm1.1:103.4: Therassa kira adhunāpabbajitassa piṇḍāya carato ekaṃ itthiṃ disvā rāgo uppajjati.
vsm1.1:103.5: Tato ānandattheraṃ āha – ‘‘Kāmarāgena ḍayhāmi, cittaṃ me pariḍayhati; Sādhu nibbāpanaṃ brūhi, anukampāya gotamā’’ti. (saṃ. ni. 1.212; theragā. 1232);
vsm1.1:103.6: Thero āha – ‘‘Saññāya vipariyesā, cittaṃ te pariḍayhati; Nimittaṃ parivajjehi, subhaṃ rāgūpasañhitaṃ; Asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi, ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ. (saṃ. ni. 1.212; theragā. 1233-1234); ‘‘Saṅkhāre parato passa, dukkhato no ca attato; Nibbāpehi mahārāgaṃ, mā ḍayhittho punappuna’’nti. (saṃ. ni. 1.212);
vsm1.1:104.1: Apica indriyasaṃvarapūrakena bhikkhunā kuraṇḍakamahāleṇavāsinā cittaguttattherena viya corakamahāvihāravāsinā mahāmittattherena viya ca bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.1:105.1: Kuraṇḍakamahāleṇe kira sattannaṃ buddhānaṃ abhinikkhamanacittakammaṃ manoramaṃ ahosi,
vsm1.1:105.2: sambahulā bhikkhū senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā cittakammaṃ disvā ‘‘manoramaṃ, bhante, cittakamma’’nti āhaṃsu.
vsm1.1:105.3: Thero āha ‘‘atirekasaṭṭhi me, āvuso, vassāni leṇe vasantassa cittakammaṃ atthītipi na jānāmi,
vsm1.1:105.5: Therena kira ettakaṃ addhānaṃ vasantena cakkhuṃ ummīletvā leṇaṃ na ullokitapubbaṃ.
vsm1.1:105.8: Anusaṃvaccharaṃ bhūmiyaṃ kesaranipātaṃ disvāvassa pupphitabhāvaṃ jānāti.
vsm1.1:106.1: Rājā therassa guṇasampattiṃ sutvā vanditukāmo tikkhattuṃ pesetvā anāgacchante there
vsm1.1:106.2: tasmiṃ gāme taruṇaputtānaṃ itthīnaṃ thane bandhāpetvā lañjāpesi ‘‘tāva dārakā thaññaṃ mā labhiṃsu, yāva thero na āgacchatī’’ti.
vsm1.1:106.4: Rājā sutvā ‘‘gacchatha bhaṇe, theraṃ pavesetha sīlāni gaṇhissāmī’’ti antepuraṃ abhiharāpetvā vanditvā bhojetvā
vsm1.1:106.5: ‘‘ajja, bhante, okāso natthi, sve sīlāni gaṇhissāmīti therassa pattaṃ gahetvā
vsm1.1:106.6: thokaṃ anugantvā deviyā saddhiṃ vanditvā nivatti.
vsm1.1:106.7: Thero rājā vā vandatu devī vā,
vsm1.1:106.8: ‘‘sukhī hotu, mahārājā’’ti vadati. Evaṃ sattadivasā gatā.
vsm1.1:107.2: tumhe raññepi vandamāne deviyāpi vandamānāya ‘‘sukhī hotu, mahārāja’’icceva vadathāti.
vsm1.1:107.3: Thero ‘‘nāhaṃ, āvuso, rājāti vā devīti vā vavatthānaṃ karomī’’ti vatvā
vsm1.1:107.4: sattāhātikkamena ‘‘therassa idha vāso dukkho’’ti raññā vissajjito kuraṇḍakamahāleṇaṃ gantvā rattibhāge caṅkamaṃ ārūhi.
vsm1.1:107.5: Nāgarukkhe adhivatthā devatā daṇḍadīpikaṃ gahetvā aṭṭhāsi.
vsm1.1:107.7: Thero ‘‘kiṃ nu me ajja kammaṭṭhānaṃ ativiya pakāsatī’’ti attamano majjhimayāmasamanantaraṃ sakalaṃ pabbataṃ unnādayanto arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
vsm1.1:108.1: Tasmā aññopi attatthakāmo kulaputto – Makkaṭova araññamhi, vane bhantamigo viya; Bālo viya ca utrasto, na bhave lolalocano. Adho khipeyya cakkhūni, yugamattadaso siyā; Vanamakkaṭalolassa, na cittassa vasaṃ vaje.
vsm1.1:109.3: Sā taṃ āha – ‘‘gaccha ayye, bhātu santikaṃ gantvā mama aphāsukabhāvaṃ ārocetvā bhesajjamāharā’’ti.
vsm1.1:109.5: Thero āha – ‘‘nāhaṃ mūlabhesajjādīni saṃharitvā bhesajjaṃ pacituṃ jānāmi, apica te bhesajjaṃ ācikkhissaṃ –
vsm1.1:109.6: ‘‘ahaṃ yato pabbajito, tato paṭṭhāya na mayā lobhasahagatena cittena indriyāni bhinditvā visabhāgarūpaṃ olokitapubbaṃ,
vsm1.1:109.7: iminā saccavacanena mātuyā me phāsu hotu, gaccha idaṃ vatvā upāsikāya sarīraṃ parimajjā’’ti.
vsm1.1:109.8: Sā gantvā imamatthaṃ ārocetvā tathā akāsi.
vsm1.1:109.9: Upāsikāya taṃkhaṇaṃyeva gaṇḍo pheṇapiṇḍo viya vilīyitvā antaradhāyi,
vsm1.1:109.10: sā uṭṭhahitvā ‘‘sace sammāsambuddho dhareyya, kasmā mama puttasadisassa bhikkhuno jālavicitrena hatthena sīsaṃ na parāmaseyyā’’ti attamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.
vsm1.1:110.1: Tasmā – Kulaputtamāni aññopi, pabbajitvāna sāsane; Mittattherova tiṭṭheyya, vare indriyasaṃvare.
vsm1.1:111.4: Tasmā anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ pahāya vīriyena piṇḍapātacariyādīhi sammā esanāhi esā sampādetabbā
vsm1.1:111.5: parisuddhuppādeyeva paccaye paṭisevamānena aparisuddhuppāde āsīvise viya parivajjayatā.
vsm1.1:112.2: dhammadesanādīhi cassa guṇehi pasannānaṃ gihīnaṃ santikā uppannā paccayā parisuddhuppādā nāma.
vsm1.1:112.4: Pariggahitadhutaṅgassa piṇḍapātacariyādīhi dhutaguṇe cassa pasannānaṃ santikā dhutaṅganiyamānulomena uppannā parisuddhuppādā nāma.
vsm1.1:112.5: Ekabyādhivūpasamatthañcassa pūtihariṭakīcatumadhuresu uppannesu ‘‘catumadhuraṃ aññepi sabrahmacārino paribhuñjissantī’’ti cintetvā hariṭakīkhaṇḍameva paribhuñjamānassa dhutaṅgasamādānaṃ patirūpaṃ hoti.
